attr.title: The ReThing
attr.desc: Experimental ARM64 port of The Thing (2002). This build targets H700 with proprietary Mali GLES. User-owned game files required; stable 30 FPS is not achieved.
attr.inst: Copy The ReThing.sh and the the_rething folder into ports (not the other ZIP files). For a new install put the supported ISO in the_rething/source/the_thing.iso and launch The ReThing; existing bin, data, config and userdata are kept on upgrade. No Python required. Requires Bash, glibc 2.36+, SDL2, SDL2_ttf and libmali.so.0. See README.md for the supported ISO checksum.
